title: incomplete
description: Present only when a derivative was left out, each entry saying why. The Python relaxation workflows refuse to run on a result whose forces are incomplete.

forces.description: Why the forces are incomplete: a force term Q3 cannot yet compute was left out.

stress.description: Why the stress is incomplete: a stress term was left out, or the topology skipped the stress entirely, in which case there is no stress_tensor or pressure record.
